No B66 premise group is introduced.

The historical “114 inferential +1check” remains an attributed historical statement. It was neither overwritten nor used as a default typing rule. Agreement here does not assert that each premise applies, is necessary, or is sufficient with its companions.

### Three remaining source questions, confined to these rows

The null conclusions are faithful disclosure, not omissions hidden by the42 supplied choices. All six affected uses stay premise: U19.1,U22.1,U50.1,U50.2,U50.3,U50.4. Both sides' member lists and all six owner/display excerpts match the frozen P bytes, including B51/P441 only;442 is blank.

| Owner and preserved members | Exact source evidence | Supported interpretation and narrow remaining question |
|---|---|---|
| B19/P357: U19.1; display B20/P359–361: U20.1–U20.4 | P357: “The pointwise selection estimate supplies the stronger difference statement”. The immediately following display is the compact difference bound at359–361. | The natural displayed target is B20. P357 does not state a separate intermediate inequality. Does G-B19's imported selection contribution target that same displayed result jointly with G-B20, or is there a genuinely distinct source-stated claim at an existing exact locator? Naming B19 as a second conclusion solely to obtain uniqueness would not answer this. |
| B22/P367: U22.1; display B23/P369–370: U23.1,U23.2 | P367: “Integrating the density versions gives the following expected per-unit-volume results for the same spatial/mark-restricted populations:”. Is its whole-owner contribution to B23 the same displayed target as G-B23, or is there a distinct source-stated intermediate claim with an exact existing span? Preserve the shared restricted-population and per-volume qualification either way. |
| B50/P439: U50.1–U50.4; display B51/P441: U51.1 | P439: “Conditional endpoint determinant-product moments on this domain are at most C(1+|b|)^(2d). The Kac-Rice height transformation (f(M),f(S))=(b,b-ell) has absolute determinant ONE here. Integrating over b and the compact relative-position domain gives”. P441 is `0<=nu_eld^far(ell)<=nu_cand^far(ell)<=C, 0<ell<=1`. | The moment and Jacobian sentences are real local assertions, but the complete four-use owner also includes the integration and marked-KR contributions ending at B51's far-bound chain. They cannot be discarded as caption/context or represented by just the first two sentences. Does that whole group contribute to the same display as G-B51's mark inequality, or can an existing source-stated intermediate faithfully carry all four members? No such distinct whole-group intermediate is established by the present record. |

Thus the next consultation can be restricted to **these three contribution/target relations**, with the exact excerpts above. My descriptive reading favors the displayed targets B20/B23/B51; it does not silently fill the nulls or decide cross-owner composition. If those targets are retained for both owners, the contract must represent or conservatively refuse that relation explicitly. A uniqueness rule cannot create a source statement. Do not merge owners, move uses, turn groups into alternatives, add an intermediate unit, or retype the six premises merely to fit a rule.
